Iron bolt

Internal ID: BoltIron | Type: Bolt | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Wood x8, Feathers x2, Iron x1

Introduction. Iron bolts are ammunition for crossbows and are the next direct upgrade from Bone bolts.

Availability. It is unlocked after building or using a black forge and is also crafted at one.
